title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: Debuting in late March, 2019, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Clay' marked the first time a 350 would be released in adult, kids and infant sizes. The infant-sized Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant 'Clay' mimics the larger versions, with a Primeknit upper that features a variety of patterns in orange-brown with a horizontal contrast stripe. A bright orange heel tab adds an accent, and the silhouette sits atop a translucent midsole and rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘MX Carbon’ updates the futuristic clog with a colorful blended palette. Made with lightweight yet durable EVA foam, the molded one-piece build is finished in a swirling mix of black, grey, yellow, and pink. Ventilation ports of varying shapes and sizes provide airflow throughout the vamp and midfoot, while the sculpted collar and heel offer a secure fit. Exterior branding is limited to a discreet adidas logo on the outsole.
